title: Who owns your street?
excerpt: 90,949 property titles in England and Wales are held by companies incorporated abroad. I mapped them for every small area: 76% are held from Jersey, Guernsey, the Isle of Man, the BVI and the UK's other islands and territories.
seo_description: 90,949 titles in England and Wales held by overseas companies, mapped by small area: 76% from UK-linked islands and territories.
header_alt: Title card on pale paper reading 'Who owns your street?' with the numbers 90,949 and 76% beside a map of England and Wales shaded by overseas-company titles per 1,000 homes, darkest in central London.
